description: TrustAnchor has all-public fields (lines 179-182) and a new() constructor that does no validation. A caller can write TrustAnchor { subject: ..., subject_public_key_info: empty_spki } or call new() with an empty/zeroed SPKI and chain_walk will attempt to use it for signature verification, likely producing an opaque SignatureInvalid or panic in the backend. The constructor should validate that subject_public_key_info.subject_public_key is non-empty and return a Result, or the fields should be private with only from_cert() and new() as constructors.
title: TrustAnchor pub fields allow construction with empty SPKI
